blurb: `D1.peek(<participant>.<Capability>)` gives an `integration` or `system` case a read-only handle on a participant's test database. Only those tiers stand one up, so the handle is refused in a `unit` case, a `property`, and in the app's own code. A `unit` case reads the capability it stubs.
summary: `D1.peek` is used outside an `integration` or `system` case; only those tiers stand up a participant's test database.
